title: Recommendation activation bridge, Part 1: manual-only source_type widening (community/health) + activation audit event
hazards_found_and_corrected: autopilot_actions has a category CHECK constraint (health/community/media/discover/calendar) and a user_id NOT NULL FK with ON DELETE CASCADE to auth.users - it is a not-yet-launched user-facing recommended-action-card table, not an orphaned audit table; writing activation-audit rows there was rejected in favor of enriching the existing dev_autopilot.execution.bridged OASIS event.

isExecutableSourceType() is the same allowlist autoApproveTick() polls for autonomous execution; widening it directly would have armed the autonomous loop against 307 existing community/health recommendations (measured live) with no code review gate. Fixed by introducing a separate, wider allowlist used only by the human-triggered activation path.

verification.jest_regression_sweep: 11 suites, 138/138 tests passing (9 pre-existing suites unmodified, 2 new)

not_done: Part 3: live verification against a real community/health recommendation on staging/production
